port_halden.msg: Road closed: a chain across the road. Port Halden opens after Mr. Vance's visitor calls (day 3).
port_halden.hint: Port Halden: after the Vance visit (day 3)
port_halden.gossip: They've chained the road to Port Halden. Folk say it opens once Mr. Vance's man pays you a call, day three or so.

harbour.msg: Road closed: the harbour road opens after Mr. Vance's visitor calls (day 3).
harbour.gossip: Harbour road's shut too, same as the city one. Wait for the Vance visit.

circuit.msg: Gate locked: the race circuit opens after Mr. Vance's visitor calls (day 3).
circuit.hint: Race circuit: after the Vance visit (day 3)
circuit.gossip: You won't get onto the race circuit yet. The gate stays locked till Vance's people have been round.

highlands.msg: Rockfall on the road: ask at the Town Hall ledger in Port Halden first.
highlands.hint: Highlands: read the Town Hall ledger first
highlands.gossip: Rockfall up the Highlands road. The Town Hall clerk keeps a ledger that might explain things; look there first.

vance.msg: Vance Aerospace is fenced off. Clear the Vance debt to be noticed.
vance.hint: Vance yard: clear the Vance debt
vance.gossip: Vance Aerospace? Fenced off tight. They only open the gate for people who've settled their debts.
